title: Subdivision tree removal letter from Arborist Committee
summary: A letter to the subdivision's board will go on the August agenda for the committee to approve. The chair asked to be told of the board's next meeting so a committee member can attend. This follows a homeowner's testimony against the board's plan to remove trees, though the committee said it does not have any regulatory power.
